newsitem.title: UK: Caradon agrees 190 mln stg Euro sale.
newsitem.headline: Caradon agrees 190 mln stg Euro sale.

text.p: Building and materials supplier Caradon Plc said on Tuesday it has agreed outline terms for the proposed disposal of most of its European engineering and distribution businesses for over 190 million stg.
The fifteen businesses concerned had ongoing profits of 21 million stg last year on turnover of 264 million stg.
"These are good businesses with good prospects, but are not a mainstream activity for us," said Caradon's group chief executive Peter Jansen in a statement.
"Disposing of them would bring added focus and opportunities to our building products activities in Europe, and is in keeping with our stated strategy."
The 190 million stg approximated to the book value of the businesses, including attributed goodwill of 80 million stg, Caradon said.
